name: What can go wrong when a bathroom fixture is installed incorrectly?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when a bathroom fixture is installed incorrectly?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common problems are leaks, poor alignment, loose mounting, slow drainage, and fixtures that do not fit the existing rough-in dimensions. In older homes around Denver-area neighborhoods, worn shutoff valves, outdated plumbing, or irregular framing can also complicate the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bad installation can lead to leaks, wobbling fixtures, drainage problems, and water damage behind walls or under floors. Older plumbing or incorrect sizing can make the problem worse.
